diagrams.title: Day 1 turns a chat into a journal page and files it on disk
diagrams.caption: Day 1 turns a chat into a journal page and files it on disk. Day 2 starts with an empty notepad, searches the cabinet by meaning, and pastes the best page into the new question. **Long-term memory = retrieve, then paste into the prompt.**
